profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer · Agent Engineering Platform team at Salesforce · Creator of Tuna & Rolo
profile.summary:
I taught myself to code by building a website for the publishing company I co-founded in college. While I was a full-time high school teacher working on it, someone noticed and said "you know you can make a career writing code," and now, here we are.

Thirteen years later I'm a Principal Software Engineer at Salesforce, where I architected and built the agentic chat UI used on Salesforce's public marketing properties, powered by Agentforce. I also own and manage digital marketing's design system's component library which powers this and other experiences on our websites. Before that, I rebuilt Salesforce's entire B2C identity UI flow: TBID, the auth layer for 4M Trailblazer accounts.

I'm a product builder in my spare time. I'm launching Tuna, a consumer mobile app for enabling eating at home to save money and use what you have with receipt scanning, pantry management, meal planning, and an adaptive menu that helps you always know what you can order from your own kitchen. I'm also relaunching Rolo, a family contact app with family tree features that already has over 1,000 users and has earned a second life based on praise and user feedback.

What I do: found products from scratch, grow them into shared infrastructure, build them off at scale. MFE architecture, design systems, auth platforms, LLM integration, mobile, marketing, and web. Comfortable at every layer: from frontend UI to backend & data to DevOps & cloud.

Self-taught. Still learning.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: St Louis, Missouri, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Built the Agentforce web chat experience end-to-end, from proof of concept through production, live on salesforce.com (~400 sessions/min, 10K/min at peak) and expanding across multiple public digital properties in Salesforce's ecosystem
  - Architected a Runtime Module Federation system enabling decentralized micro-frontend contributions with independent deployments, shared dependencies, and optimized bundle sizes, enabling scaled integrations with MicroFrontends with shared state and React context
  - Founded the WES design system (React + Tailwind) for digital marketing UI components and atomic styles, now adopted across 8+ Salesforce public properties and powering tens of millions of page views/month across Salesforce web properties
  - Built Salesforce's modern B2C identity UI on top of Okta's JS SDK, with social login, SSO, MFA, and signup flows serving 3–5M+ accounts globally across Salesforce, MuleSoft, Tableau, Trailhead, and Dreamforce

positions.title: Principal
positions.description:
- Focused on both sales and delivery solutions, meeting with clients to discover opportunities.
- Leads solution delivery as Dev Lead, Technical Architect, and Delivery Solution Lead.
- People Manager responsible for guiding consultants and senior consultants on their growth through their Slalom career path
- Provides development team architecture and leadership to implement solutions
- Produces architecture deliverables on discovery projects with clients covering technical and cloud infrastructure, cost analysis between various options, and business impact evaluations
- Primarily focused on full-stack software solutions leveraging custom frontend apps in React, Vue, and Angular, backend compute in Node and Java, databases in Postgres, DynamoDB, MongoDB, and Firestore, cloud platforms on AWS and GCP, and platforms including Salesforce and AEM.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
- Leading teams building great products for our awesome clients with modern technology.
- Dev lead for 2 years for a team of several developers building new digital product for a client which built a data visualization Nuxt app with AWS Amplify as well as a Serverless API backed by AWS API Gateway and NodeJS Lambda using SAM, integrating with an RDS Aurora Postgres DB using RDS Proxy and Sequelize
- Championed Agile best practices and worked directly with client stakeholders and dev team leaders to learn best practices with planning, estimating, and demoing Scrum sprints and retros 
- Assumed the role as solution architect after 1 year into the project to continue to maintain and scale the database, specifically its schema and ERP, as well as work directly with client stakeholders to estimate and commit to roadmaps for releases
- Scaled this same app out to be released in AWS China, enabling the deployments to target China partition and leveraging feature flagging to configure features which were not supported in those regions
- Led the team in best practices for testing and deployment, especially around integration testing with Postman, code reviews and git branching/merging strategies, and pipeline configuration with Azure Pipelines
- Built custom frontend Vue data visualization components with D3, SVGs, and Tailwind for dynamic range and time series visualizations and featuring dynamic gradients for the scales for visual comprehension
- Integrated AEM components with customer's in-house Material-inspired Design Language System (DSL) and leveraging the same system for multiple brand expressions across multiple products, simplifying theming decisions and keeping development consistent
- Led best practices and integration for DSLs on various client platforms, from AEM to in-house applications built in Vue, React, and Angular

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
2017-Current: CRM & Marketing, Developer and SEO Analyst for Corporate Website
- Sole-dedicated Wordpress Developer for our company's public website: www2.wwt.com.
- Growing WWT as a thought leader in the industry by developing, designing, and maintaining the website
- Implementing better SEO strategies based on Google Analytics, Google Webmasters, and Marketing Cloud
- Salesforce developer assisting CRM initiatives including implementing Salesforce Lightning

2015-2017: Order Management Grails & Angular App Developer
- Built a Sales Order API for internal applications to get normalized data from our Oracle backend using Grails 3 and hosted in Cloud Foundry
- Developed an Angular Order Status UI and Grails Order Status API which helped our sales enablement team know where a customer order was at any time in its lifecycle, rolled up into stages in a 'ribbon' style component, along with other relevant data for our orders
- Developed an Angular admin interface for managing how RabbitMQ messages were processed by an API to catch any errors around live data which could potentially effect others
- Helped migrate a handful of applications from our old Weblogic platforms to Cloud Foundry, updating Angular and Grails 2 & 3 projects in order to handle the new environment
- Agile Team Coach responsible for facilitating meetings for different teams and planning/leading team Agile ceremonies including Retrospectives, Grooming, and Standups.
- Attended NgConf '16 in Salt Lake City and presented on Angular2 to WWT's custom apps developers
- Attended Agile Conference in St. Louis '15 and was certified in Agile coaching

2014-2015: ServiceNow Admin & Angular App Developer
- Developed an internal Agile Storyboard app built in ServiceNow which served our entire IT department the same way Trello works for other organizations
- Attended Knowledge '14 in San Francisco and participated in the pre-conference training courses for SN Developers
